act_title: The Goa, Daman and Diu (Administration) Act, 1962
title: Power to extend enactments to Goa, Daman and Diu
text:
6. Power to extend enactments to Goa, Daman and Diu.—The Central Government may, by

notification in the Official Gazette, extend with such restrictions or modifications as it thinks fit to Goa,
Daman and Diu any enactment which is in force in a State at the date of the notification.

7.[Extension of the jurisdiction of Bombay High Court to Goa, Daman and Diu.] _Rep. by the_

_Goa, Daman and Diu Judicial Commissioner's Court (Declaration asHigh Court) Act, 1964 (16 of 1964),_
_section 8 (w.e.f.16-12-1964)._
